headerDisplay: Sensors are discovered automatically over Bluetooth — no need to list them below unless you want to customize a specific one or ignore an unwanted one.

ignoredAddresses.title: Ignored Sensor Addresses
ignoredAddresses.description: BLE addresses to never expose as an accessory, e.g. a neighbor's sensor picked up over BLE.

sensors.title: Per-Sensor Overrides

bindKey.title: Bind Key (encrypted sensors)
bindKey.description: Only needed if this sensor broadcasts encrypted (the CGDK2 default, unless paired via the Qingping+ app to force unencrypted mode). See README > Encrypted sensors (bindKey).

fakeGatoOptions.title: FakeGato Options
fakeGatoOptions.description: Advanced. Extra options passed straight through to the fakegato-history constructor, merged over (and able to override) this plugin's computed filename/path/storage. See the fakegato-history documentation for available options. Not editable from this form (it's an open-ended object) — switch to the JSON config editor for this plugin to set it.

sensors.description: Optional. Customize a specific sensor once you know its address (see README > Multiple sensors), or override any default below just for it. Sensors not listed here are still discovered and exposed automatically using the defaults.

timeout.title: Timeout (minutes)
timeout.description: Default: time in minutes after last contact when a sensor should be regarded as unreachable. If set to 0, timeout will be disabled.

forceDiscovering.title: Enable Force Discovering
forceDiscovering.description: Retry start scanning for devices when stopped. For some users scanning will be stopped when connecting to other BLE devices. Setting forceDiscovering to true will start scanning again in these cases.

forceDiscoveringDelay.title: Force Discovering Interval (seconds)
forceDiscoveringDelay.description: The delay, in seconds, before scanning restarts after it stops unexpectedly. Only applicable if forceDiscovering is true. Retries automatically back off (up to 60s) if the adapter keeps failing to restart.

updateInterval.title: Update Interval (seconds)
updateInterval.description: Default: by default values will be updated as they come in. Often this is once per second, if this is not desired updateInterval can be set to how often updates should be made. Accepts values in seconds.

disableBatteryLevel.title: Disable Battery Level
disableBatteryLevel.description: Default: if battery level should not be exposed to Homekit. New E-Ink sensors do currently not support sending battery levels and setting this to true will make Elgato Eve not warn about it.

lowBattery.title: Low Battery Threshold
lowBattery.description: Default: at what battery percentage Homekit should start warning about low battery.

logSignalStrength.title: Log Signal Strength (RSSI)
logSignalStrength.description: Default: log each sensor's Bluetooth signal strength (RSSI) at info level, without needing full debug logging.

temperatureOffset.title: Offset - Temperature
temperatureOffset.description: Default: an offset to apply to temperature values for calibration if measured values are incorrect.

humidityOffset.title: Offset - Humidity
humidityOffset.description: Default: an offset to apply to humidity values for calibration if measured values are incorrect.

fakeGatoEnabled.title: Enable FakeGato
fakeGatoEnabled.description: Default: enable to send historical data to the Elgato Eve app.

fakeGatoStoragePath.title: FakeGato Storage Path
fakeGatoStoragePath.description: Default: optional, specify a custom path to save FakeGato history.

fakeGatoOptions.title: FakeGato Options
fakeGatoOptions.description: Advanced. Extra options passed straight through to the fakegato-history constructor, merged over (and able to override) this plugin's computed filename/path/storage. See the fakegato-history documentation for available options.

mqtt.title: MQTT
mqtt.description: Default MQTT configuration applied to every discovered sensor unless overridden per-sensor above.
